Band 3500 has 4 cells (highest density of any band), confirming a 5G NR mid-band emphasis suited for urban/suburban dense deployment.
Capacity score of 25.6 is among the highest in the neighbor ring — its shutdown removes a significant 5G capacity node from the local grid.

Despite the micro form factor, capacity_score=23.4 is high due to the large 5G cell count; primary backup role is feasible from a load perspective.
Identical configuration to USID_00 (macro 40m, 4 4G + 6 5G, 4 bands, capacity_score=25.6) — strong symmetric backup for E/SE sector.

Full 5G capability ensures no service degradation for 5G users handed over from USID_00.

nsa_5g_downgrade_risk.explanation: Primary backup USID_27 has 8 5G cells (more than USID_00's 6), so NSA 5G users handed over to USID_27 retain 5G service. No downgrade risk from the primary backup path. Note: USID_41 (secondary backup for 34.62% of pixels) has only 2 5G cells, which may cause 5G quality reduction for that subset, but does not constitute a full NSA downgrade as some 5G capacity remains available.

capacity_verdict_reasoning: Primary backup USID_27 has capacity_score=23.4 and 8 5G cells — it matches or exceeds USID_00 in 5G cell count, confirming adequate 5G capacity absorption.
USID_29 and USID_37 both share USID_00's exact configuration (capacity_score=25.6), providing high-quality backup for E/SE and S sectors respectively.
Post-outage load factors across all backups are in the 0.005–0.013 range — well below the 0.5 MEDIUM threshold — confirming that available capacity vastly exceeds absorbed load.

Only USID_41 (capacity_score=15.6, 2 active bands) represents a reduced-capability backup, but it handles only 34.62% of pixels and carries post_outage_load_factor=0.012, leaving substantial headroom.
key_findings_for_stage4: No NSA 5G downgrade risk from primary backup path (USID_27 has 8 5G cells vs USID_00's 6), but users redirected to USID_41 may see reduced 5G throughput due to its 4G-heavy configuration (only 2 5G cells, capacity_score=15.6).

USID_00's 4-band deployment (including Band_700) provides coverage breadth that secondary backups USID_27 (2 bands, no Band_700) and USID_41 (2 bands, no Band_700) cannot fully replicate — potential degradation in building penetration and range for those sectors.
Overall neighbor ring has high aggregate capacity (scores: 23.4, 25.6, 15.6, 25.6, 22.4) with all post-outage load factors < 0.015, so capacity is not the binding constraint in this outage.

reasons: Capacity scores are pre-computed and verified against the attribute CSV — no inference required.
Tower type thresholds are strictly applied: USID_27 at 20m is unambiguously micro; all others fall cleanly into macro or tall_macro ranges.
Technology profiles are directly readable from cell counts with no borderline cases.
